name: sophos-otp-project

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable zip --x64 --publish never

description: Local OTP authenticator with encrypted profiles and Sophos Connect integration
author: Sophos OTP contributors
